# DEA — Debug Anything

> Observe any running process, container or pod from an AI coding agent. No breakpoints, no restarts, no instrumentation. Every finding cites evidence. MCP server + CLI + Python package. MIT, local-only, no telemetry.

Install: `npx dea-agents setup` (registers the MCP server and the debug-anything skill with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI). Project-level: `dea init`. Python: `pip install dea-agents` (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI adapters). Skill: `npx skills add shreyassaw5394/dea`.

MCP tools: readiness, attach, detach, list_processes, trace_syscalls, profile_cpu, dump_stacks, inspect_sockets, inspect_files, capture_traffic (consent), snapshot_memory, diff_runs, container_info, report. Prompts: dea_slow, dea_leak, dea_hang, dea_crash, dea_port_busy.

Providers: strace, py-spy, perf, lsof, tcpdump, gdb, lldb, sample (macOS), Node inspector heap snapshots, docker.
